notes: Station lists are ordered along the segment and include both endpoint stations (shared endpoints repeat across consecutive sections); n_stations is the count of NEW stations as stated by the source.
Network operational as of 2026-10: Purple 43.49 km/37 stns, Green 33.46 km/32 stns, Yellow 19.15 km/16 stns = 96.1 km, 83 stations (Wikipedia Namma Metro).
Pink elevated (Kalena Agrahara–Tavarekere): CMRS inspection 6–8 Oct 2026; no confirmed opening found as of 2026-10-16. Re-check before publishing; may open within days.
Purple MG Road–Magadi Road underground opening: 29 Apr 2016 (text) vs 30 Apr 2016 (table) in Wikipedia; year-month 2016-04 is unambiguous.
Phase 1 Mysuru Road–Magadi Road: Wikipedia phase table says 5 stations/5.12 km, line text says 6 stations/6.4 km.
Blue Line dates conflict heavily across sources (2026-12 to 2028-12); values chosen are the latest government directive reported by Deccan Herald; Swarajya (Aug 2026) says 2A slips into 2027.
Blue Line 2B: stated 16 stations (8+8) but table splits 9 (KR Pura–Hebbala) + 7 (Hebbala–KIAL). Infobox mentions 3 'future' stations (e.g. Bettahalasuru) not listed.
Orange Line: Namma Metro article table says 'Under Construction' but Orange Line page says 'Approved' with civil bidding underway; no civil award found -> marked approved.
Hosahalli–Kadabagere is shown as Grey Line on Wikipedia's Namma Metro page and module; some sources/the Orange infobox treat both Phase 3 corridors under Orange. Official BMRCL colour not confirmed.
Red Line (Phase 3A) marked 'approved' only at state level; Union approval pending. Station list reflects revised DPR as per Wikipedia (27 names vs 28 stated).
Colours are Wikipedia's Module:Adjacent_stations/Namma_Metro hexes, not BMRCL brand specs. Unassigned corridors have color null.

Renamed stations: Kalena Agrahara (was Gottigere), Tavarekere (was Swagath Cross), Hosahalli = Sri Balagangadharanatha Swamiji Station, Majestic = Nadaprabhu Kempegowda Station, City Railway Station = Krantivira Sangolli Rayanna Railway Station, Vidhana Soudha = Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Station, Central College = Sir M. Visvesvaraya Station, Bommasandra = Delta Electronics Bommasandra, Whitefield = Whitefield (Kadugodi), Yelahanka-side names Hebbal/Hebbala used interchangeably.
Magadi Road: no standalone metro extension found; the Phase 3 Hosahalli–Kadabagere corridor runs along Magadi Road, with a proposed further 6.6 km to Tavarekere (Magadi Road).
Excluded: Bengaluru Suburban Rail Project (K-RIDE, 4 corridors ~148 km, under construction) — not metro.
Wikipedia wikitext fetched 2026-10-16/17; some page sections are snapshots from ~Apr 2026 and lag news.
